review_notes: No candidates were supplied. I read all of lines 1–89. The only repeated pattern is in `GV.comp`, `VG.eval` and `GV.divByMonic_X_sub_C`. Each one rewrites a sum, applies `GV.sum` or `VG.sum`, builds one `mul` of a `pow` term, and closes with `simpa`. The three differ in direction (GV vs VG), in the sum being unfolded, and in the index. Each body is only 3–4 lines, so a shared lemma would be a thin wrapper over the existing `sum`, `mul` and `pow` API and would save little. `GV.pow` and `GV.multiset_prod` are both inductions, but their statements and steps differ. `factor_roots` is a single induction with no repeat elsewhere in the file. I did not open Val.lean, so the exact `GV`/`VG` definitions are unchecked, and I found no repeated block that would justify a refactor.
